literal_meaning: আষাঢ় মাসে গল্প (story in the month of Asharh)
figurative_meaning_en: An outright lie or complete fabrication
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বলা কথাগুলো তো আষাঢ়ে গল্প, কিছুই বিশ্বাসযোগ্য নয়।
এটা আষাঢ়ে গল্পের মতো শোনাচ্ছে, সত্যি নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His words are just like stories in Asharh – nothing but lies.
That sounds like a story from Asharh; it's completely made up.
note: Refers to exaggerated tales often shared during the monsoon month of Asharh in Bengali folklore.
